title: Collections Desk Standard: Catch-Up Payment Amount on the Missed Statement — Northgate Card
content:
**The missed statement.** On a past-due **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account the catch-up payment is measured on the missed statement, which is the statement for which the most recent late fee on the account was recorded, and of two late fees posted the same day the one entered first in the account history; the catch-up payment is recorded against the missed statement.

**When the payment is fixed.** The catch-up payment is not fixed until the most recent duplicate-posting dispute on the account, when it still stands open with its source a Northgate order on a tier without provisional dispute credits and two or more postings carrying that order's reference exceed what the order record charged, has its final credit posted.

**Payments counted.** Each payment counts against the statement whose balance it pays, and a returned payment counts against the same statement as the payment it returns.

**Minimum payment due on the missed statement.** The minimum payment due on the missed statement is the minimum printed on it, less the amount the base rule excludes while a billing-error dispute stands open: where exactly one billing-error dispute is recorded on a transaction the missed statement first showed, it still stands open with no resolution entry referring back to it and its notice was received after that statement's closing date, the minimum payment due is worked out in two steps, first the tier's minimum payment percentage of the disputed amount, rounded half up to the cent, is taken off the printed minimum, then where what remains is below the tier's minimum payment floor the floor is used instead, never more than the printed minimum; in every other case the minimum payment due is the printed minimum.

**Referral.** While the missed statement carries two or more billing-error disputes on transactions it first showed, whether resolved or not, the catch-up payment is referred to the disputes team: no catch-up payment is booked and the customer is handed over to a human representative because no published policy sets the payment in this conversation.

**Met statement.** The missed statement is met when its minimum payment due is met in full by the payments recorded against it that were not returned unpaid; while it is met, nothing is owed under this rule and the catch-up payment is nothing.

**The amount.** The catch-up payment is the minimum payment due on the missed statement less the payments recorded against that statement, and never less than zero. While the missed statement is not met, the catch-up payment adds together every amount this rule sets, each already in whole cents, and the total is kept to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical account)

| Missed statement (hypothetical) | Figure |
|---|---|
| Minimum printed on it | 72.00 |
| Billing-error disputes on transactions it first showed | none |
| Minimum payment due | 72.00 |
| Payments recorded against it | 25.00, not returned |
| Met? | no — 25.00 is short of 72.00 |
| Catch-up payment | 72.00 less 25.00, that is 47.00 |

With payments of 80.00 recorded against the same statement and none returned unpaid, the statement is met and the catch-up payment is nothing.
